device.model: HD-XS2 (Globo) / Blue XS65 (Opticum): German retail network build
device.soc: ALi M3503 (the bootloader chunk's version "M3503---0.1.0"; the main code is the SDK's "M3602 HD STB" / "S3602 HD STB" platform build with the chip's internal NIM_S3503 demodulator driver)
device.family: M3503 (chips/m3503.py: the M36xx family with the chip ID 0x3503 and the XIP bootloader's cache-as-RAM stack)
device.demod: internal (NIM_S3503_0 / NIM_S3503_1; the NIM_S3501 driver is in the build too)

image.version: 1.2.8 Rev.778 RC1 "GER_RETA_NETWORK" (main-code chunk 112003000100202, version 00000128; Libcore 11.2.0@SDK4.0fa.11.2_20130829, Application 1.0.0@SDK4.0fa.11.2_20130829, HDMI_ALI_E_130527_1; the SEE's uLibcore 1.1.5a@SDK_20111126)

simulator.note: Boots as the M3503 family (chips/m3503.py), completes the SEE's SHA-256 verification on the crypto engine and draws its German first-install wizard ("Sprache wählen") by ~100 M instructions (~241 GE commands), with the front panel showing " ON ", " on ", "Strt".

desc: The 1.2.8 Rev.778 RC1 German retail network update (2014-11-28) for the Globo HD-XS2 / Opticum Blue XS65 satellite receiver (main-code chunk 112003000100202, accepting /c/Sw_Globo_HD-XS2_Reta_ger.abs and /c/XS2_Reta_ger.abs from USB).
Built on the earlier Libcore 11.2.0 (SDK4.0fa.11.2_20130829) release rather than the 2015 Libcore 13.8.0 used by the 1.3.5 and 1.4.0 Polish builds.
